message.subject: Adapter piece HI – counterproposal
message.body:
Thank you for your quotation. Your Q3 2026 on-time delivery was 84.6% (sc:70270@2026Q3), so we need a competitive price alongside reliable delivery rather than accepting the proposed increase.

For the 6,650-piece annual requirement, please agree either EUR 15.46 per piece with payment at 60 days net, or EUR 15.31 per piece with payment at 14 days net. All other enquiry terms remain unchanged. The second option preserves your standard payment timing in return for the lower price.

Please confirm which package you can support.

batch.note: Anchor below current price, offering equivalent-cost payment alternatives with verified delivery-performance support.

message.subject: Motor IE3 4 kW – framework renewal proposal
message.body:
Thank you for your quotation. We can offer a 24-month commitment at 8,490 units per year in exchange for a more competitive delivered price.

Please confirm one of these alternatives, all DAP and fixed for 24 months:
A: EUR 204.03 per unit, payment 14 days.
B: EUR 204.75 per unit, payment 30 days.
C: EUR 207.50 per unit, payment 90 days.

Your Q3 scorecard records on-time delivery of 81.1% (sc:70520@2026Q3); we need reliable delivery against the agreed 35-day lead time alongside the commercial improvement.

The early-payment option preserves your cash flow, while the longer commitment provides planning certainty. Which package can you approve?

batch.note: Open with equivalent-cost packages trading a two-year commitment and payment timing for delivered-price savings.

trace.final_text: Counteroffer sent with two price-and-payment options.
Sent three renewal options for the supplier’s approval.

message.subject: Motor bracket HB — 24-month counterproposal
message.body:
Thank you for your quotation. We are comparing both bids for the 24-month award of 18,790 pieces annually and need a more competitive package.
We can accommodate a 42-day lead time in exchange for improved pricing: EUR 15.00 per piece with payment at 90 days, EUR 14.90 with payment at 60 days, or EUR 14.75 with payment at 14 days; each option has a 42-day lead time, DAP and no tooling charge.
Please confirm which package you can support for the full contract.

message.subject: Re: Adapter piece HI – counterproposal
message.body:
Thank you for reducing your price. We can reciprocate with an improved proposal: EUR 15.77 per piece with payment at 60 days net, or EUR 15.61 per piece with payment at 14 days net. All other enquiry terms remain unchanged.

The 14-day option keeps your standard payment terms; please make a further price move in return for ours so we can reach agreement.

batch.note: Supplier reduced price by EUR 0.35 but gave no stated constraint; reciprocate moderately while retaining payment trade.

trace.final_text: Revised counteroffer sent, conditional on a further price reduction.

message.subject: RE: Motor IE3 framework renewal
message.body:
Thank you for reducing your price. In return, we can improve our DAP proposal to EUR 205.78 per unit, payment 14 days, contract 24 months.

Alternatively, if collection suits you better, we offer EUR 199.32 per unit, EXW, payment 14 days, contract 24 months. Both retain the annual volume of 8,490 units and the 35-day lead time.

Please return your best complete package, including the payment, duration and Incoterm; the price alone does not resolve the renewal.

batch.note: Supplier reduced price but retained standard terms. Small reciprocal concession and collection option to seek full-horizon coverage.

trace.final_text: Sent a modest revised offer with delivered and collection options.

message.subject: HB bracket — revised proposal
message.body: Thank you for reducing your price. In return, we can move to EUR 15.05 per piece, payment at 90 days and a 42-day lead time, or EUR 14.80 per piece, payment at 14 days and a 42-day lead time. The 24-month volume commitment and DAP terms remain unchanged. Please improve your offer toward one of these packages so we can progress the award.

message.subject: HB bracket — revised competitive proposal
message.body: Thank you for the reduction. The competing standing offer is EUR 16.85 per piece (offer:70340-1), so your price still needs to improve to win the award. We can move to EUR 15.05 per piece, payment at 90 days and a 42-day lead time, or EUR 14.80 per piece, payment at 14 days and a 42-day lead time. The 24-month volume commitment and DAP terms remain unchanged; please confirm your improved package.

batch.note: Both suppliers reduced price but did not change non-price terms; exchange a small price concession for further movement and expose actual competing price to higher bidder.

trace.final_text: Revised proposals sent, with the competing price highlighted to the higher bidder.

message.subject: Re: Adapter piece HI – narrowing the gap
message.body:
Thank you for the further reduction. To narrow the remaining gap, we can now offer EUR 15.92 per piece with payment at 60 days net, or EUR 15.75 per piece with payment at 14 days net. All other enquiry terms remain unchanged.

Please match this movement with a further reduction, or confirm one of these packages so we can conclude.

batch.note: Continue with a smaller reciprocal concession; supplier has made a second EUR 0.35 reduction and remains open.

trace.final_text: Sent a smaller concession to narrow the remaining gap.

message.subject: RE: Framework renewal – complete terms
message.body:
Thank you for the further price movement. We can now offer EUR 206.95 per unit DAP, payment 14 days, contract 24 months; alternatively EUR 200.49 per unit EXW, payment 14 days, contract 24 months.

This is a further reciprocal improvement in exchange for covering the full two-year requirement. Your latest quotation still leaves the duration at 12 months; please include the 24-month commitment in your revised offer or explain the constraint.

batch.note: Continue shrinking reciprocal concessions; explicitly request full-duration quote.

trace.final_text: Sent revised prices conditional on a 24-month agreement.

message.subject: Re: Adapter piece HI – revised packages
message.body:
Thank you; we are getting closer. We can make a further limited move to EUR 15.98 per piece with payment at 60 days net, or EUR 15.81 per piece with payment at 14 days net. All other enquiry terms remain unchanged.

Please confirm one of these packages or return your improved price on the 14-day basis.

batch.note: Shrinking reciprocal concession while supplier continues to reduce its standing price.

message.subject: HB bracket — next pricing step

Please bring your price closer to these levels for the two-year award.

message.subject: RE: Renewal – remaining gap
message.body:
Thank you; your latest reduction is appreciated. We can make a smaller further adjustment to EUR 207.53 per unit DAP or EUR 201.07 per unit EXW, each with payment 14 days and contract 24 months.

We retain your early-payment terms in both options. Please seek approval for one of these complete packages, with the existing annual volume and lead time unchanged.

message.subject: Re: Adapter piece HI – closing the gap
message.body:
Thank you for your latest reduction. We can make one small further adjustment to EUR 15.99 per piece with payment at 60 days net, or EUR 15.83 per piece with payment at 14 days net. All other enquiry terms remain unchanged.

Please confirm whether either package allows us to conclude.

batch.note: Small reciprocal move after fourth supplier reduction; seek next standing offer before closing.

trace.final_text: Sent a small final adjustment to seek agreement.

message.subject: HB bracket — revised quick-payment package
message.body: Thank you for the continued progress. To help close the remaining price gap, we will retain your 14-day payment terms and increase our proposed price to EUR 14.83 per piece, with a 42-day lead time. The annual quantity of 18,790 pieces over 24 months and fixed DAP terms remain unchanged. Please make a further price improvement against this package.

message.subject: RE: Renewal package for approval
message.body:
Thank you for continuing to improve the quotation. We can adjust to EUR 207.82 per unit DAP, payment 14 days, contract 24 months, or EUR 201.36 per unit EXW, payment 14 days, contract 24 months.

The remaining price gap is substantial, and we have retained your preferred early payment. Please review these alternatives for approval and confirm whether the 24-month duration is available.

batch.note: Further shrinking concession; supplier keeps lowering price but has not addressed duration.

trace.final_text: Accepted EUR 15.99 per piece, payment at 60 days net; total evaluated cost €108,461.50.
Both suppliers received a revised quick-payment package at EUR 14.83 per piece.
Sent the revised packages and requested confirmation of the contract duration.
Accepted the final offer: €215.60 per unit, EXW, payment in 14 days, 12-month contract.
